serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Melissa: Excuse me, sir.
???: Just fuck off already, you augmented freak!
Melissa: …
I feel bad for witnessing this…
Before I even recognized it was Melissa who was screamed at, the douchebag was already lost in the crowd.
You: Are you ok, Melissa? That guy was way out of line.
Melissa: Who are you again?
You: It’s me! Don’t you remember?
Melissa: Right. Mr. Friend.
Melissa: Do you want something from me? There are a lot of people here, so I would rather get out of here as fast as possible.
Cold as always…
You: Sorry, I just saw you getting screamed at by that guy and thought that I should at least reach out to you.
Melissa: Ok. {{wi}}Anything else?
You: Don’t be like that. He must have freaked you out, right? Are you alright? 
Melissa: I’m ok. Such minor inconveniences happen all the time even though I try to not bring attention to myself.
You: I see…
She has it tough…
You: If you want, we can talk about it somewhere. 
#Cashier.Face.hmmm
Melissa: You should already know well that I have no interest in talking with you, so if you want me to entertain you with a conversation, just say so instead of giving me an illusion of a choice.
#Cashier.Face.normal
You: Come on now, aren’t you a little harsh on me? I’m still hoping that after we get to know each other, meeting with me and {f_botName} won’t be such a chore for you.
Melissa: Whatever. Just say where you want to go already. I got off my shift early and I don’t want all my free time to be wasted on you.
You: Understood…
